dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-section toward the anterior and posterior poles.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse greyish textural variations across the central dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between subtle pigment variations.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of fine, parallel linear marks on the lower right dorsal region and a few small, faint circular pockmarks near the central axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent longitudinal crease or ridge is visible along the central-left dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Cluster of faint, parallel linear scratches on the lower right quadrant of the dorsal surface.
